final: WITH line_totals AS (SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(SUM(x.cost), 0) AS total_cost, COUNT(x.expense_id) AS expense_count FROM budget b LEFT JOIN expense x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY b.budget_id), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_spend FROM line_totals) SELECT AVG(l.total_cost) AS average_total, SUM(l.expense_count) AS expenses_altogether, AVG(l.total_cost - a.avg_spend) AS average_excess FROM line_totals l CROSS JOIN baseline a WHERE l.total_cost > a.avg_spend
